=You are at: STEP 1 of 6 — Add Form Template
Status: PAUSED — waiting for your input
Template: {{ $('Check Step 1').first().json.template_ref }} — {{ $('Check Step 1').first().json.title }}

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
WHAT YOU NEED TO DO:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

1. Go to Supabase Storage → panicleDevelop_1 → PDF-templates/{{ $('Check Step 1').first().json.template_ref }}/

2. MAPPING EXCEL ({{ $('Check Step 1').first().json.template_ref }}_mapping.xlsx):
   • Download the file
   • Review columns C-E (auto-mapped fields, confidence, score)
   • Edit COLUMN F (Manual Override) to correct any wrong mappings
   • Format: data_key [source]  e.g. mobile_number [user_details]
   • Leave column F blank if the auto-mapping in column C is correct
   • Upload the edited file back to the same folder

3. EXTENDED INFO EXCEL ({{ $('Check Step 1').first().json.template_ref }}_extended_info.xlsx):
   • Download the file (contains unmapped fields)
   • Fill COLUMN D (Extended data source): data_key [user_details]
   • Fill COLUMN E (Extended data value): the actual value
   • Upload the edited file back to the same folder

4. Choose your pipeline path below:
   • Path A (Simple): Use if you've manually mapped all fields and provided all values
   • Path B (Full): Use if you want the system to auto-generate missing data via AI

5. Click Submit when both files are uploaded

values.option: path_b — Full pipeline (gap analysis + synthetic + realistic data)
path_a — Simple (manual mapping + extended data only)
